subject: Re: win8 shiny 0.2.3 Error in shell.exec(url)

messages.author: f806781d102fe0ab
messages.subject: Re: win8 shiny 0.2.3 Error in shell.exec(url)
parts:
This looks like your browser might be misconfigured. From the desktop, if you do Win+R, and type http://www.google.com as the command, does it work or do you get an error? If the latter, try making your browser of choice the default browser (again) and hopefully it will fix those associations.

Regardless, this should only affect when Shiny tries to launch a browser for you for convenience. You could call runApp with launch.browser=FALSE and open up a browser yourself and navigate to http://localhost:8100.
